articles.title: Putin special envoy speaks at White House event on Oleshky ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump
articles.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin’s envoy appeared with first lady Melania Trump at the White House on Thursday as she brought together Russian and Ukrainian officials to mark the localized ceasefire she brokered between their nations. Speaking at the invitation of the first lady, Kirill Dmitriev thanked Trump for her “distinguished humanitarian role” in securing the ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. President Donald Trump did not appear. Dmitriev added that Putin personally gave instructions as part of the operation and sent his thanks to Melania Trump. The event included officials from Russia and Ukraine to honor the ceasefire, which was signed Oct. 23.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine trade airstrikes as reconstruction and security talks resume in Brussels
articles.description: Russia and Ukraine have traded damaging airstrikes as talks resume in Brussels to discuss Ukraine's post-war reconstruction and security guarantees. The latest Russian aerial barrage highlights the rebuilding task ahead. Ukraine fired hundreds of drones at Russian targets. The Russian defense ministry said that its forces shot down nearly 500 drones overnight. Rescue teams continued searching on Thursday for more than 30 people trapped in the wreckage of a former school hit by Russian bombs on Monday. Talks are happening in Brussels involving officials from the U.S., U.K., France, Germany, the European Union and NATO. They are focusing on post-war reconstruction and security guarantees for Ukraine.

articles.title: Turkey's Erdogan says he wants to discuss ending Russia-Ukraine war with Putin after talks with Zelenskiy
articles.description: ANKARA, Nov 5 (Reuters) - Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan said he wanted to speak to his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin to discuss efforts to end the war in Ukraine, after talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy on Saturday.Speaking to reporters on a return flight from South Korea, Erdogan said his foreign minister and other relevant officials were holding talks with both sides for a potential meeting between Russia and Ukraine in Turkey, according to a transcript of his comments shared by his office on Thursday.

articles.title: Ukraine, US, Russia to hold working-level trilateral talks within a week: Zelenskyy
articles.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced upcoming trilateral talks with the US and Russia to discuss the ongoing war. The discussions with US envoys lasted for an hour and a half and focused on security and diplomatic efforts. A significant meeting in Brussels facilitated collaboration on Ukraine's postwar recovery and security guarantees. Meanwhile, Russia continues its attacks on Ukraine, prompting increased mediation from the US.

articles.title: State of the World from NPR
articles.description: Kherson is a city in southern Ukraine whose population numbered in the hundreds of thousands before Russia’s invasion of the country.  Just a fraction of those people live there today.Russia occupied Kherson for a few months in the early days of the war and ever since Russian forces withdrew across the Dnipro River, the city has largely been under siege with frequent shelling and drone attacks.  But a limited ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine this past weekend gave residents of Kherson a break from fighting.  Allowing them to walk the streets and see friends again.We go to a temporarily peaceful Kherson to hear how residents are living under the constant threat of bombing and drone attacks.Support public media with NPR+ and enjoy perks for over 25 podcasts like this one. This show’s perks include sponsor-free listening. Learn more at plus.npr.org.
